A tennis ball of mass $0.060 \text{ kg}$ travels horizontally and strikes a vertical wall at $30 \text{ ms}^{-1}$. It leaves the wall in the opposite direction at $20 \text{ ms}^{-1}$.
The graph shows how the resultant horizontal force acting on the ball varies with time during this collision.
What is the duration of the collision?
